Heard.
Learned CSC takes notice for the 
respondents.
Counter affidavit to be filed within 
three weeks.
Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, may be filed.
List on 06.06.2025 for final hearing.
Heard on interim relief applications. 
Having considered, this Court is of the 
view that interim relief applications may 
only be decided once the respondents are 
permitted to file objections.
The respondents may file objections to 
the interim relief application by the next 
date of listing.
